Description

The Corrupted Deadwood is a tree introduced during the 2024 Halloween Event. Unlike the rest of the event, however, the Corrupted Deadwood and the other corrupted items were planned to be a permanent addition to the game.

It can be obtained by exposing Deadwood to a spore made by Mysterious Mushrooms (Formally found in the Desert on the Ferwater Island in the Corrupt Biome). It is identified by its small size, the lack of any leaves, and its purple corrupted color. Unlike other trees in the game, its sanded texture is different from the normal wood. It has a unique pattern of lighter-colored waves of purple.

Like any other material in the game, you can use logs, sanded, and planked Corrupted Deadwood to complete schematics.

Trivia

  • It is a little larger than a regular Deadwood tree.
  • The Corrupted Deadwood was introduced during the 1.68.0 "The Spooky Month" update alongside The Corrupted, Corrupted Acacia Tree, Corrupted Cactus, Corrupted Tumbleweed, and Corrupted Limestone.
